# gomd

```go
import "github.com/kinorai/omnifeed/benchmark/fetch/gomd"
```

Command gomd is the Go converter candidate for benchmark/fetch/run.py: one plain GET, then HTML to markdown in Go, the way a plain\-HTTP first step in omnifeed's generic engine would do it. It is a separate module so the converter libraries stay out of omnifeed's go.mod until one is chosen.

```
go build -o /tmp/gomd .
/tmp/gomd -mode raw  URL   the page minus omnifeed's excluded tags
/tmp/gomd -mode read URL   Readability's main content first
```

It prints one JSON object: \{"markdown": ..., "error": ...\}.
